svg.title: Sveinbjorn — bear and wilderness logo
svg.desc: A right-facing geometric bear constructed from the SVEINBJORN wordmark, with mountain, pine-tree and river cut-outs. Traced from the approved raster artwork into editable vector paths. Fine grain has been removed; broad colour shading is represented by native SVG gradients. The lettering is outlined artwork, not live font text. Transparent background and true transparent cut-outs.

g.inkscape:label: Teal — lettering, forest and rear leg
Orange — lettering, mountain ridge and front legs
